```{r}
# packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ape, future.apply, ggtree, ggbreak, ComplexHeatmap, hues, ggnewscale, tidytree) 

# tree (takes time to run)
tree <- read.tree("./data/phylogeny/source/cognac_nj.tre")
tr <- ggtree(tree)

# relevant metadata
ng_amrsearch <- read_csv("../../data/pathogenwatch_metadata/Neisseria_gonorrhoeae_amrsearch.csv") %>% subset(`Genome Name` %in% tree$tip.label)
ng_snps <- readRDS("../../data/ng_pathogenwatch_files/ng_snps.RDS") %>% subset(`Genome.Name` %in% tree$tip.label)
ng_meta <- left_join(ng_amrsearch[,c(-1,-3,-4)], ng_snps[,c(-1,-3,-4)], by = join_by(`Genome Name` == `Genome.Name`)) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(ng_meta)[1] <- "Isolate"
rownames(ng_meta) <- ng_meta$Isolate

metadata <- read.csv("../../data/pathogenwatch_metadata/Neisseria_gonorrhoeae_metrics.csv") %>% subset(Genome.Name %in% tree$tip.label)
metadata <- metadata %>% mutate_if(colnames(.) %in% c("Genome.Length","No..Contigs","Smallest.Contig","Largest.Contig","Average.Contig.Length","N50","GC.Content"),as.numeric)
ng_mlst <- read_csv("../../data/pathogenwatch_metadata/Neisseria_gonorrhoeae_mlst.csv") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(ng_mlst) <- ng_mlst$`Genome Name`

# clustering results
clr_collapse <- readRDS("./data/phylogeny/source/distinct_profiles/cluster_collapse.RDS")
clr_str <- readRDS("./data/phylogeny/source/distinct_profiles/cluster_str.RDS")
clr_stats <- readRDS("./data/phylogeny/source/distinct_profiles/cluster_stats.RDS")
prof_ids <- readRDS("./data/phylogeny/source/distinct_profiles/profile_id.RDS")
clr_res_list <- readRDS("./data/phylogeny/source/distinct_profiles/cluster_results_list.RDS")
```

# isolate selection

```{r}
# method 1: random selection of isolates
clr_collapse <- clr_collapse %>% mutate(iso_sel_random = sapply(str_split(isolates, ","), function(x) sample(x, 1)))

# method 2: by genome quality then random sampling
samp_by_qual <- function(iso_vec) {
  iso_vec <- as.character(iso_vec)
  iso_list <- str_split(iso_vec, ",") %>% unlist()
  if(length(iso_list > 1)) {
    iso_sub <- metadata %>% subset(`Genome.Name` %in% iso_list) %>% 
      subset(No..Contigs == min(.$No..Contigs, na.rm = T)) %>% 
      subset(N50 == max(.$N50, na.rm = T)) %>% .$Genome.Name
    return(sample(iso_sub, 1))
  } else {
    return(iso_vec)
  }
}

clr_collapse$iso_by_qual <- sapply(clr_collapse$isolates, samp_by_qual) #takes a few mins

```

```{r}
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) + xlab("Genome Length (bp)") + ylab("") + theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# visualize isolate selections on tree
## selection df
iso_sel_df <- metadata %>% select(Genome.Name)
rownames(iso_sel_df) <- iso_sel_df$Genome.Name
iso_sel_df <- iso_sel_df %>% 
  mutate(thresh_350 = ifelse(Genome.Name %in% isos_3000,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(thresh_450 = ifelse(Genome.Name %in% isos_2500,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(thresh_650 = ifelse(Genome.Name %in% isos_2000,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(thresh_1050 = ifelse(Genome.Name %in% isos_1500,1,0)) 

## ST data
common_STs <- table(ng_mlst$ST) %>% sort(decreasing = T) %>% head(35) %>% names()
colors <- iwanthue(35, plot = F)
color_vector <- setNames(c(colors, "#FFFFFF"), c(common_STs, "0"))

ST_color <- scale_fill_manual(breaks = names(color_vector),values=color_vector,labels = c(names(color_vector)[-36], "other") ,name="ST",guide="none")

ng_mlst_ST_labelled <- ng_mlst %>% mutate(ST_labels = ifelse(ST %in% common_STs, ST, 0)) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(ng_mlst_ST_labelled) <- ng_mlst_ST_labelled$`Genome Name`
p0 <- gheatmap(tr, data = ng_mlst_ST_labelled %>% select(ST_labels), width = 0.25, color = NULL, colnames_position = 'top', colnames_offset_y=670) + ST_color + ylim(NA, 33500)
p1 <- p0 + new_scale_fill()
## tree
snp_color_vec <- setNames(c("red", "#FFFFFF"), c("1", "0"))
SNP_color <- scale_fill_manual(breaks = names(snp_color_vec),values=snp_color_vec,labels = names(snp_color_vec),
                               name="included isolate",guide="none")
iso_sel_df[,-1] <- lapply(iso_sel_df[,-1], as.factor)
p2 <- gheatmap(p1, data = iso_sel_df[,-1], offset = 0.001, color = NULL, colnames_position = 'top', colnames_offset_y=620, font.size = 2, colnames_angle = 90) + ylim(NA, 33600) + SNP_color

p2

## color the largest distinct profiles on tree
top_isos_t350_df <- clr_collapse %>% subset(threshold == 350) %>% arrange(desc(count)) %>% .[1:35,] 
top_isos_t450_df <- clr_collapse %>% subset(threshold == 450) %>% arrange(desc(count)) %>% .[1:35,]
top_isos_t650_df <- clr_collapse %>% subset(threshold == 650) %>% arrange(desc(count)) %>% .[1:35,] 
top_isos_t1050_df <- clr_collapse %>% subset(threshold == 1050) %>% arrange(desc(count)) %>% .[1:35,] 

top_prof_df <- iso_sel_df %>% select(Genome.Name)
top_prof_df$thresh_350 <- 0
top_prof_df$thresh_450 <- 0
top_prof_df$thresh_650 <- 0
top_prof_df$thresh_1050 <- 0

rank_profiles_isolates <- function(df, threshold_col) {
  for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    isolates_list <- strsplit(df$isolates[i], ",")[[1]]
    matching_rows <- rownames(top_prof_df) %in% isolates_list
    top_prof_df[[threshold_col]][matching_rows] <- i
  }
  return(top_prof_df)
}

top_prof_df <- rank_profiles_isolates(top_isos_t350_df, "thresh_350")
top_prof_df <- rank_profiles_isolates(top_isos_t450_df, "thresh_450")
top_prof_df <- rank_profiles_isolates(top_isos_t650_df, "thresh_650")
top_prof_df <- rank_profiles_isolates(top_isos_t1050_df, "thresh_1050")

# append the cluster number ids
clr_str_thresh <- clr_str %>% select(c("350", "450", "650", "1050"))
clr_str_thresh$Genome.Name <- rownames(clr_str_thresh)
left_join(top_prof_df, clr_str_thresh) -> clr_id_df

prof_color <- scale_fill_manual(breaks = names(color_vector_prof),values=color_vector_prof,labels = c(names(color_vector_prof)[-(length(color_vector_prof))], "other") ,name="prof",guide="none")
top_prof_df[,-1] <- lapply(top_prof_df[,-1], as.factor)

dp2.0 <- gheatmap(dp1, data = top_prof_df %>% select(thresh_450), width = 0.25, offset = 0.00205, color = NULL, colnames_position = 'top', colnames_offset_y=620) + ylim(NA, 33600) + prof_color
```
